source: authenticated project-scoped Supabase execute_sql, read-only aggregate
query: SELECT count(*)::integer AS provider_user_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE email IN ('vs02a-student-a@vs02a.invalid','vs02a-student-b@vs02a.invalid','vs02a-candidate-c@vs02a.invalid') AND role = 'authenticated' AND is_anonymous = false AND email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)::integer AS approved_confirmed_fixture_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM auth.sessions) AS remaining_provider_sessions, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'identity') AS identity_schema_present FROM auth.users
